final: WITH j AS (SELECT o.ordertune AS t, COUNT(*) AS c FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), s AS (SELECT t, c, c*1.0/(SELECT SUM(c) FROM j) AS sh FROM j), a AS (SELECT AVG(sh) AS av FROM s) SELECT SUM(c) AS total_count, AVG(sh) AS avg_share, AVG(sh - av) AS avg_excess FROM s, a WHERE sh > av
